#### Notable changes

**New options**
* `@Sse({ maxPendingDataLength })` sets how many characters of event data may wait for a client that is not reading its events (4M by default; `0` or `Infinity` lifts the limit) – [2f05ad954e](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/2f05ad954e2ca7633d6c90b0e4268e6d9ef0e6d8)
* `IoAdapter` and `WsAdapter` take `maxConcurrentMessages`, the number of a client's messages handled at once (1000 by default; `Infinity` lifts it) – [0bd0810ed7](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/0bd0810ed7625744f34cf32698f723b8b8e6d024)
* `ValidationPipe` takes `maxErrorMessagesLength` (1,000,000 characters by default); messages past it are replaced by a "Further validation errors were omitted" entry – [086c1c514f](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/086c1c514faf8e04922c63fb4cd8bca87d90ced3)
* Kafka: `parser.maxMessageSize` (16 MiB after decompression by default); larger messages are logged and skipped – [9bdf844fca](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/9bdf844fca9f88d659678bb060ad8369c297ab3e)
* TCP server: `drainTimeout` (30 s by default, `0` disables) disconnects a peer that leaves its responses unread – [583d6077ad](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/583d6077ad3b58aeffb91636d6cded6f8c2f3ee1)
* MQTT server: `reconnectOnConnackError` is now enabled by default, so a refused connection attempt is retried; set it to `false` for the previous behaviour – [a63cea600a](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/a63cea600a17cfe486f8fe7fcd679325c589615c)
* `HttpServer.getRouteMatchingOptions()`, an optional adapter hook that tells core how the router matches paths (see "Middleware exclusions" below) – [08d8677c8d](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/08d8677c8d576119669b12e109ee6513319a6c4e)

**New defaults and behaviour changes**
* `@nestjs/platform-express`, `@nestjs/platform-fastify`: `fieldNestingDepth` and `fieldArrayIndexLimit` ([#18074](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18074)) now default to 32 and 1000; set them to `Infinity` to lift the limits – [94fcc93770](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/94fcc937706978c9305b2486f38643cfdf37bab9)
* `ValidationPipe` validates with `validationError.target: false` unless the options set it, so an `exceptionFactory` that reads `error.target` gets `undefined`; set `validationError.target` to `true` for the old errors – [8c5a59bf63](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/8c5a59bf63c0d68a462c085ee2976a7d5b1aba9a)
* `ValidationPipe` answers an array or a primitive sent for a validated class with a 400 – [197371c1f3](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/197371c1f3902254bcec09e2fa46bd35b889b1be)
* `FileTypeValidator` matches a string `fileType` up to the end of a name (e.g. `font/woff` no longer accepts `font/woff2`; use a RegExp for that) – [770c6f1a19](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/770c6f1a191830b1c9a19f33b0f0e08cb45f8a8e)
* `@SerializeOptions({})` on a handler no longer turns off the class schema – [d27cb7017f](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/d27cb7017fd9f21dadfd078791ffe8fe5a25644c)
* `BaseExceptionFilter` answers `http-errors` errors created with `expose: false` (the default from 500) with the standard reason phrase instead of their message – [9ed572f853](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/9ed572f853bb164feb4f9a5a8ae1f4537ba57118)
* A `StreamableFile` error still gets a 400, but the body no longer carries the error message – [2f28d91afb](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/2f28d91afb743e9475de72521cb87cf8c5f3892d)
* Files uploaded with a request that a pipe rejected are removed from storage – [acb98de89e](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/acb98de89ea4b782403329eb76837f7089ad7974)
* `@nestjs/platform-fastify`: a route with `fileSize: undefined` (or `null`) falls back to the plugin's limit; set it to `Infinity` to keep uploads unlimited – [dd549e1a74](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/dd549e1a741c5a1f5eb6b729b8d2cc664bb8f338)
* `@nestjs/platform-express`: object error bodies are sent as `application/json` on routes with a non-JSON `Content-Type` – [7dc6e349d5](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/7dc6e349d525d82d73c2576cf57b8297de254a64)
* `ConsoleLogger` in JSON mode cuts a record short past about a million characters – [ad4915eaa3](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/ad4915eaa357698e004efd8e0fc66aec2651e132)
* A global enhancer that the injector failed to instantiate now fails the application at startup – [ae78524ced](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/ae78524ced7f4ad4886ab031dd8abc78cf6a6b1e)
* A request- or transient-scoped `APP_FILTER` now logs a startup warning, as it only applies to exceptions thrown from controllers – [df5275c5e1](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/df5275c5e18c99854efb42119496244082ebec0c)
* Microservices: a pattern key longer than 256 characters matches no handler – [accd27e66c](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/accd27e66c090f8f78efd8653b0c968286414c0a)
* Kafka: a message may carry up to 10,000 header values ([e419ff540b](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/e419ff540b261ce23dde58e80b19daefa46e89ba)); headers given as a string or array are not sent ([312777743f](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/312777743fce3f553febb69624e97bf624770392)); reply headers are decoded as text ([ee94f6aaae](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/ee94f6aaae19a8654b8455f67e9fe972ff355907))
* gRPC: request streams are paused while their replies wait to be written – [37e5cf7706](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/37e5cf77062f2f373809dd9ed290e0ed8424a717)
* **Deprecation**: on TCP, Redis, NATS, MQTT and RabbitMQ, an `@EventPattern()` handler that replies to `ClientProxy#send()` now logs a deprecation warning. The reply is unchanged; in the next major version event handlers will not reply to `send()`, as on Kafka already – [ba3668d36b](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/ba3668d36b6c4e13a2b8617fcfb0a5fe624e04e6)

**Middleware exclusions**
* `MiddlewareConsumer.exclude()` now compiles excluded routes with the router's case and trailing-slash matching ([08d8677c8d](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/08d8677c8d576119669b12e109ee6513319a6c4e)). Update `@nestjs/core` together with `@nestjs/platform-express` / `@nestjs/platform-fastify`: with an adapter that does not implement `getRouteMatchingOptions()`, excluded routes are matched exactly ([f5aa875e40](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/f5aa875e407d186d8cc86cf0ad62cfcbdea490f6)), so on a lenient router other spellings of an excluded path run the middleware.
* With header, media type or custom versioning, `exclude({ path, method, version })` and `enableCsrfProtection({ exclude })` apply only to requests that ask for one of the excluded versions – [1a7a31fa46](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/1a7a31fa46756875e1dc33de0185edadb06504d9)
* `@nestjs/platform-fastify`: the request hook used by `enableCsrfProtection()` and `useSecurityHeaders()` now runs before Nest and `app.use()` middleware with `NestFactory.create()` too, including middleware registered before either call, as it already did with `Test.createNestApplication()` – [8351806290](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/commit/8351806290ff90905a0190429e46e290ec0e7494)
